model_choice: Exact MCLP with binary x_i and y_j variables. N~24 sites => 48 vars. Fits easily in CGA backend (<3600 vars). Uses linear constraints for cardinality and coverage implications.

prep.notes: Filtered population data to Da'an District, Taipei City for the latest period (Year 115, Month 12). Extracted neighborhood centers from the Da'an District boundary dataset, converted coordinates from TWD97 TM2 to WGS84. Joined population totals to neighborhood centers using normalized names. Sites are the 24 neighborhoods in Da'an District.
